items.evidence: Log 1-3 open lid and set block to 4 C. Then each of the 8 wells gets a 1 uL aspirate from plasmid_plate X1 and a 1 uL dispense into transformation_plate X1, with a fresh tip each time.
Log 84-87: lid closed, then 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s, 4 C for 2 min, all on the thermocycler.
Log 89-168 add 50 uL SOC to each well A1-H1 after the shock. Log 170-171 close the lid and hold 37 C for 60 min.
Each plasmid and each SOC addition uses its own pick up and drop tip pair (log 4-83, 89-168). No tip is reused across wells and no pipetting happens without a tip.

The LV volumes (1 uL DNA, 10 uL cells, 50 uL SOC) and the 4 C/30 min, 42 C/30 s, 37 C/1 h programme all match the paper. The 2 min chill and the 45 C lid are disclosed as choices in the code comments, and the citation in the metadata is accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the simulator log and the paper: 1 uL DNA into 10 uL cells with the block at 4 C, 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s with the lid closed, then 50 uL SOC and 37 C for 1 h. Every transfer uses a fresh tip and all tips are dropped, so all items pass.
